name: Hiræth
source:
Bernard, a red deer, has decided to miss his train back home to try and have one last conversation with Felipe, his now ex-boyfriend of six years.

[From [url=https://dojopar.itch.io/hiraeth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伯纳德是一只红鹿，他决定错过回家的火车，尝试与交往六年的前男友费利佩进行最后一次交谈。

[来自[url=https://dojopar.itch.io/hiraeth]Itch.io[/url]]
